svg.title: Modeled builds: planner vs claim

svg.text: Claims are the build creators' own figures and are unverified (one is the user's in-game estimate). One build is measured in game: its 60 s run's average

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is compared with the planner's 60 s recount average, not the sustained figure. The planner's figures are model estimates on the Lv.85 training dummy,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: best-case conditions; each build's audit lists what is modeled, what is provisional and what is still open. The in-game dummy recount displays at most

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 T, so a claim above 10 T cannot be read off the recount directly.
